title: ENTRY timeframe lever: the pooled ENTRY pipeline at 5m / 15m / 1h / 4h bars, bar-count and clock-time scaling, with and without v2's cost gate; which features and which edge scale (units b620..b626, harness scripts/research/ml_entry_timeframe.py)
note: Operator ~22:35Z (relayed): 'queue a training session for 5 minutes bars as well so we can compare results and see what scales tfs and what doesn't'. Seven dev-only units, rule registered first, P2 priority 1: b620-01 (1h harness reproduction of the round-1 base +0.0089), b621/b622 (15m bar/clock), b623/b624 (5m bar/clock), b625/b626 (4h bar/clock). Each re-runs the 1h baseline inside itself, reports gross R / cost R / net R, ungated and with v2's cost gate, gain-share + SHAP-sign stability vs 1h, and signal overlap with the 1h model. Rows (INFERRED): 5m bar-count ~8M, 15m bar ~2.7M, others ~668k (1h measured). ETA: 1h ~25 min, 4h ~40 min, 15m 1-2.5 h, 5m clock ~1.5 h, 5m bar-count ~5 h (runner, 330 min cap). Forward read on the decision-logging lane's 15m/5m shadow scores is owed once those rows exist. Gates this adds: none. Held PR. READ 2026-11-04 (TIER3-RESULTS-READ-20261104). Population: ENTRY pipeline, 60 perps, DEV FOLDS ONLY (8 folds, tau 0.10, seeds 7/11/13), full cost stack; no held-out read. GATE: b620-01 (1h harness) = DOES_NOT_REPRODUCE: seed-mean +0.01078 vs round-1 +0.00895 (tol 0.0005), n 71,302/71,580/71,393 within 1% of round 1 (-0.9%). Its own rule says 'fix the harness before any other timeframe unit is read', so everything below is PROVISIONAL. Per unit (ungated seed-mean net R/decision, cost R/decision; 1h base +0.0108 net, 0.064 cost): b621 15m bar -0.0128, cost 0.093 = not_viable; b622 15m clock -0.0627, cost 0.111 = not_viable; b623 5m bar -0.0603, cost 0.092, n~25.9k = indeterminate (a fold <1000 gated decisions; point estimate negative); b624 5m clock -0.0874, cost 0.153 = indeterminate (gated n~1,040); b625 4h bar -0.0141, cost 0.041 = not_viable (signal rate 63%); b626 4h clock +0.0115 net, gated +0.0171 vs 1h gated +0.0226 = viable_not_better. READING: gross R/decision does not rise on shorter bars (0.06-0.09 vs 0.08 at 1h) while cost/decision rises 1.4-2.4x, so the edge does NOT scale to 15m/5m; it holds at 4h on a 1h clock and ties 1h, never beats it. No Tier-3 proposal. NEXT: harness repro diagnosis (3,071 fewer 1h decision rows than round 1 is the first suspect) -> then re-grade b621-b626 unchanged. CORRECTION (TIER3-RESULTS-READ-20261104, after check): b623/b624 are INDETERMINATE because the registered every-fold>=1000-decisions condition fails UNGATED too: min fold n = 33/79/61 (5m bar, seeds 7/11/13) and 627/448/536 (5m clock); gated min fold n 9-25 and 3-4. Not a 'gated only' effect; point estimates negative regardless. [2026-11-05 lane ML-FS-RECIPE] b620-01 DOES_NOT_REPRODUCE DIAGNOSED (evidence comms/research/RQ-20261101-b620-01/diagnosis-20261105/). (a) Round-1 builder vs timeframe-harness builder on the same 60 symbols: 665,156 rows each, 0 row or feature differences, so the harness is NOT mechanically faulty. (b) Round 1's table had 664,786 dev rows, today's 665,156: the input data moved. (c) Round 1's OWN code on today's data gives +0.01256 (seeds .0166/.0110/.0101), not round 1's +0.00895, and b620 gave +0.01078: round 1 does not reproduce itself either. The fixed-tau seed range (0.0065-0.0136) is 13-27x the registered 0.0005 tolerance, so the unit's rule cannot be met by a re-run. b620's verdict stands as registered; no rule changed. Consequence for b621-b626: their fail/indeterminate reading rests on a 1h baseline of +0.0108, and the new-data round-1 code gives +0.0126, so the 15m/5m/4h deltas against 1h are unchanged in sign (all were negative or tied).
